Both ranks passed exact prepared tensors/state-bin prompts,771near-boundary state tests and matching loss/all805trainable gradients; all candidates retained15%GPU/conservative node-memory headroom. Each variant timed200decoded updates after10warmup, excluding checkpointIO. Results:synchronous existing pipeline37.3343samples/s, worker-side CPU prompt/token preparation36.8687, plus transfer-prefetch with8workers37.1636, plus12workers37.6568; unchanged control repeat37.6656. Best candidate was0.0234%slower than the final unchanged control; its0.42%advantage over the mean of controls is smaller than the0.89%control drift. Warmed baseline loader wait was only0.0237s across171.42s (0.01384%). No convincing speedup from these CPU changes, so none was promoted into production. The CPU/CUDA profiler captured18,898kernel-launch API calls per update; its6.54sloader time includes cold startup and is separate from warmed timing. Further candidates should target GPU/kernel-launch overhead, H200-only autocast weight-cache or activation-checkpoint recomputation tradeoffs, each with new equivalence/memory measurements before deployment. These are untested next directions, not speedup claims. Root`/scratch/aparame/Dynamic_VLA/pi05-cpu-pipeline-20261021`, local evidence`maintenance/pi05_cpu_pipeline_20261021/assessment.json`. Production checkpoint60,004 remains intact; no production restart, source/recipe/precision/LR/budget change or new W&B run was issued. The startup SIGUSR1 recovery issue and the independent earlier handoff-check failures remain recorded separately; the existing follow-up monitor remains paused.
